name: Teal Boomerang
description: Teardrop "boomerang" shapes scattered in a mixed ink palette.

code.style: --rule: ( background-size: 200px 200px; background-image: @doodle( background-color: var(--color1); background-image: @m(10, (@doodle( @grid: 1 / 50px; background: transparent; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); } transform: rotate(@r(360deg)) scale(@r(.5, 1)); clip-path: @shape( split: 50; scale: .3; x: cos(t) + cos(2t) * 2; y: sin(2t) + sin(t) * 2; ); ))); background-position: -25px 45px, 50px 75px, 90px 95px, 160px 165px, 20px 0, 22px -65px, 110px -18px, 120px 34px, 130px 125px, 5px 90px; ); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
